newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures end firm in currency driven trade.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures end firm in currency driven trade.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures ended firmer after a day of purely currency driven business, traders said.
"We need another external feature apart from currency, but we can't seem to get it at the moment," one trader said.
Sellers held off early in the day, in the face of a stronger sterling, before bids for the EU tender were known, but when the information became available there was some business, traders said.
In the afternoon sterling took over completely. As it eased against the mark futures came back to unchanged. Business later in the day was "good two way trade," one trader said.
Active May wheat last traded 0.10 stg higher at 94.80 stg, having seen a low of 94.25 stg. There were 236 lots of May traded out of a total of 658 lots of wheat.
Barley was more active than in recent days, with 100 lots traded. May was most active, with 40 lots. It last changed hands at 0.25 stg lower at 93.80 stg.
